units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67">Gen. R. s. 67</cite> (ref. to <he>אצלת</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 27:36">Gen. XXVII, 36</cite>) <he>מן הנ׳</he> ed. (Ar. <he>הנִצּוֹלוֹת</he>) of the leavings (of the poorest kind).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74:3">Gen. R. s. 74</cite> (ref. to <he>ויצל</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 31:9">Gen. XXXI, 9</cite>) <he>כזה שהוא מציל מן הנ׳</he> (Ar. <he>הנצולות</he>) like one that saves things from among the refuse.—Pl. <cite ref="N00750"><he>נִיצּוֹלוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="N00746"><he>נִצּ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 10:3">Tosef. Ter. X, 3</cite> <he>הניצולית וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.; ed. Zuck. <he>המצולות</he>) the leavings and the rotten fruits &c.—V. <cite ref="N01131"><he>נָצַל</he></cite> a. <cite ref="N01104"><he>נְצוּלָה</he></cite>.
